1.title: Attacker in Minneapolis Shooting Had Threatened Residents, Records Show
1.summary: The gunman, who fatally shot two people and wounded several others at an apartment building where he lived, was facing eviction.

2.title: Hillary Clinton, Meghan Markle, Lena Dunham and Others Pay Tribute to Gloria Steinem
2.summary: After Ms. Steinem’s death at 92, celebrities and politicians reflected on her decades of activism for women’s rights and equality.

3.title: Los Angeles District Bans Most A.I. for Students
3.summary: New York City announced a similar plan. The Los Angeles moratorium appears to go further with strict limits even for older students.

4.title: Spain’s Leader Questions Morocco Border Control During Ceuta Migrant Surge
4.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of Spain said the role of Moroccan authorities at key moments needed to be “clarified.” But he rejected any suggestion they had planned the crisis.

5.title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
5.summary: Her foundation said she "passed away peacefully" at her home in New York City, "surrounded by many who loved her".

6.title: Israel Is Expected to Release Lebanese Prisoners, in Rare Sign of Progress
6.summary: The move would come amid struggling talks between Israel and Lebanon aimed at disarming Hezbollah and ending Israel’s invasion.
